answer: Mechanism: each payout (nectar) flows only from an escrow pool (the oasis) that pays a key presenting a fresh signed pulse plus an admission bond minted by proof-of-work seeded with the key's secret and epoch. How: one key mints one bond and emits one pulse per epoch; the oasis verifies both before paying nectar and forfeits bad bonds. Attacker cost: each of N puppets mints its own bond and signs its own pulse on its own secret - N distinct PoW proofs, no bulk discount - while an honest user pays once; key resets restart the PoW, keeping marginal cost linear in N.
